name: Watch Stats
description: Brings play counts from Tautulli or Tracearr into Seerr: what your users are actually watching, what is trending, and what to watch next.

permissions.name: View Own Watch Stats
permissions.description: See your own play counts and what you have been watching.

permissions.name: View All Watch Stats
permissions.description: See every user's play counts, and the server-wide trending list.

settings.name: Watch history source
settings.description: Where play records come from. Tautulli uses the server Seerr is already configured with; Tracearr needs the host and token below.

settings.name: Tracearr URL
settings.description: Base URL of your Tracearr server, including any path prefix — for example https://tracearr.example.com. Ignored when the source is Tautulli.

settings.name: Tracearr API token
settings.description: A public API token from Tracearr’s Settings › General. Starts with "trr_pub_".

settings.name: Trending window (days)
settings.description: How far back the "trending on your server" list looks. Longer is steadier; shorter reacts faster.
